CustomField.description: Roll-up sum of NRC_Amount__c across all Quote Lines. NRC_Amount__c formula returns $0 for non-NRC lines, so this sums only one-time charges. Used in NRC credit limit check.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sum of all one-time charges across quote lines. Auto-calculated from line items (UnitPrice x Quantity for NRC lines). Used for NRC credit limit validation. Read-only.
CustomField.label: Total NRC (Quote)
